title: State Limits on Agency Recovery Fees under Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Schedule of state limits on the class fee for an involuntary recovery under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The state that decides the limit is the contract state recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts.

**Rule.** Where the contract's state is one of IA, MN or WI, the class fee is limited to 500.00; where it is one of IL, MI or OH, the class fee is limited to 550.00; in any other state the class fee stands with no state limit.

| Contract state on the contract | Limit on the class fee |
|---|---|
| IA, MN, WI | 500.00 |
| IL, MI, OH | 550.00 |
| any other state | no state limit |

A limit caps the class fee; a class fee already at or below the limit is unaffected by it.

## Illustrations (hypothetical class fees)

| Contract state | Class fee | Class fee after the state limit |
|---|---|---|
| WI | 1,000.00 | 500.00 |
| OH | 1,000.00 | 550.00 |
| TX | 1,000.00 | 1,000.00 (no state limit) |
| IA | 300.00 | 300.00 (below the limit) |

## Basis Q&A

- *Which state counts?* The contract state recorded on the Retail Installment Contract, not a state mentioned in conversation.
- *Does the limit depend on the collateral class?* No; the same limit applies to every class's fee.
